semiconductor_relevance: High — Chroma Japan provides a range of semiconductor test solutions and equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Chroma Japan specializes in semiconductor test solutions, offering advanced ATE and PXI systems, IC handlers, and system-level test solutions. Their products cater to various applications, including consumer SOCs, power management ICs, and RF components, ensuring reliable performance and quality testing.
capabilities: ATE and PXI systems for consumer SOCs and power management ICs
IC handlers with temperature control and bare die handling
Burn-in and life testing equipment for laser diodes
Automated system solutions for system-level testing

regional_presence.Japan: Chroma Japan operates in Japan, focusing on providing semiconductor test solutions to local markets.
